definitions.explanation: a line segment connecting two non-adjacent vertices of a polygon

examples.japanese: ⟦{正方形|せいほうけい}→正方形：05438_seihoukei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対角線|たいかくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: To draw the diagonal of a square.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長方形|ちょうほうけい}→長方形：05439_chouhoukei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対角線|たいかくせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}する→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧。
examples.english: To calculate the length of the diagonal of a rectangle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{六角形|ろっかくけい}→六角形：28900_rokkakukei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{九本|きゅうほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対角線|たいかくせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
{対角線|たいかくせん} is a line segment connecting two non-adjacent vertices (corners) of a polygon.

WRITING:
- ⟦{対|たい}→対：03382_tai⟧: opposite, facing
- {角|かく}: angle, corner
- ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧: line

MATHEMATICS:
The number of diagonals in a polygon with n sides is n(n-3)/2. For example, a square has 2 diagonals, a hexagon has 9.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {対角線|たいかくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw a diagonal
- {対角線|たいかくせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧: length of a diagonal
- {対角線|たいかくせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧: to divide by a diagonal
